findings.message: Screen has a list (LazyColumn/LazyRow) but no empty-state branch. Users see a blank screen when there is no data.
findings.suggestion: When the list is empty, show an icon + descriptive message (e.g. "No listings yet — tap + to add your first space.").

findings.message: KYC screen is missing: no loading state, no error state. Users have no feedback during the KYC submission process.
findings.suggestion: Add isLoading + errorMessage state to KycViewModel and show them in KycScreen.

findings.message: Screen has no visible error feedback. Failed network or permission operations go unnoticed by the user.
findings.suggestion: Add errorMessage: String? to the screen's state and display it in a Snackbar or a red Text composable.

findings.message: "as any" bypasses TypeScript type-checking — runtime type mismatches become silent bugs.
findings.suggestion: Use a proper type assertion or unknown + type guard instead of "as any".

findings.message: Cloud Function "recomputeKycLevel" is exported but never called via getHttpsCallable() in Kotlin. May be a trigger/HTTP endpoint or dead code.
findings.suggestion: Verify this is intentional. If dead code, remove it to keep the deploy surface small.
